spec: WBS-3 server/core/config.py + pipeline_engine.py: SCRATCHPAD_DIR, MAX_FANOUT_TASKS=64, MAX_QA_REVISIONS=3; mtime-cached load_sku_template; get_stage_config(sku,stage); parse_wbs (fenced json / bare json, list or {tasks}); plan checkpoint -> scratchpad section 1; fan-out next stage into N kind=code child tasks (idempotent, fallback to single task on unparseable/oversize WBS); fan-in barrier (all stage siblings done/merged) -> single qa_review task with aggregated diffs + scratchpad section 2; dispatch_fix_for_revision (blocked QA task + code-stage fix task, reopen on fix completion, qa_hold after MAX_QA_REVISIONS); emit directives (wbs / qa_verdict) appended to specs.
